query: Marvell Technology electro-optics revenue Q3 fiscal 2026 quarter
normalized: 2026 electro fiscal marvell optics q3 quarter revenue technology

output.content:
Marvell did **not disclose a standalone dollar revenue figure for its electro-optics business** in Q3 fiscal 2026 (the quarter ended November 1, 2025). Management instead said that revenue from its **optical-interconnect businesses grew by double digits sequentially**, driven by demand for PAM DSPs, TIAs and drivers. [[1]] 

For context, Marvell reported total Q3 FY2026 revenue of **$2.075 billion**, including **$1.518 billion of data-center revenue**. [[2]]
